A dated price list for AI models (model × token type), refreshed every hour from the public genai-prices list (MIT license) into a table we keep. Prices are USD. Each row has two dates: `source_effective_from`, the source's own date, and `effective_from`, the instant we apply it from. A change never reprices usage recorded before it. Every usage line that bills from the list cites the row it used (`mpr_…`), and you can get that row here.

**Your cost** is the price your organization pays its model provider. It feeds cost and margin, and is the markup base when a price asks for it. The sync never changes it.

## Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | [`/v1/organization/model_cost_overrides`](/help/developers/api-reference/model-prices/list-your-costs) | List your costs |
| `POST` | [`/v1/organization/model_cost_overrides`](/help/developers/api-reference/model-prices/set-your-cost) | Set your cost |
| `GET` | [`/v1/organization/model_cost_overrides/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/model-prices/retrieve-your-cost) | Retrieve your cost |
| `DELETE` | [`/v1/organization/model_cost_overrides/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/model-prices/delete-your-cost) | Delete your cost |
| `POST` | [`/v1/organization/model_cost_overrides/{id}/end`](/help/developers/api-reference/model-prices/end-your-cost) | End your cost |
| `GET` | [`/v1/organization/model_prices`](/help/developers/api-reference/model-prices/list-model-prices) | List model prices |
| `GET` | [`/v1/organization/model_prices/{id}`](/help/developers/api-reference/model-prices/retrieve-a-model-price) | Retrieve a model price |
| `GET` | [`/v1/organization/model_prices/drift`](/help/developers/api-reference/model-prices/list-drift) | List drift |
| `GET` | [`/v1/organization/model_prices/history`](/help/developers/api-reference/model-prices/price-history-of-a-model) | Price history of a model |
| `GET` | [`/v1/organization/model_prices/source`](/help/developers/api-reference/model-prices/price-list-source) | Price list source |
